title: trust-bundle remove reports a revocation it never performs
description:
persona/src/main.rs:434-436. 'remove' prints 'trust-bundle removal not yet implemented' to STDOUT and returns Ok, so the process exits 0. personad is never contacted.

Direction matters here. The enroll no-op closed in .103 granted nothing and therefore denied nothing, which is a fail-closed nuisance. This one FAILS TO REVOKE, which is fail-open. An operator withdrawing trust in a compromised federated domain runs 'persona trust-bundle remove compromised.example', sees a benign line and a zero exit, and concludes the anchor is gone. It is still live and tokens from that domain keep validating. Any runbook step of the form 'persona trust-bundle remove X && echo revoked' passes.

It is also the weakest-worded of the three stubs: unlike 'add' it does not even say 'requires personad support', so nothing hints the daemon was never asked.

Found by the discovery lens while fixing .103; confirmed by reading the code.
acceptance_criteria: trust-bundle remove exits non-zero and says no revocation happened, until the daemon implements it.
